cohort: 3633 parturients from Luanda, Angola, aged 13 to 48 years.
finding: A low percentage (0.4%) of parturients tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 on the day of delivery, with a lower chance of infection among those from urbanized areas; none of the newborns tested positive in the first 24 hours after birth, while one newborn tested positive seven days after birth.
